contributions.claim: WHO says a 12th infected person was detected in the Netherlands and urges countries to monitor cruise-ship passengers.
contributions.attribution: WHO and Tedros via Al Jazeera
contributions.uncertainty: Title total implies cumulative 12, not 12 new Dutch cases. Ship/name and patient identity absent.

relations.reason: Same country, reporting day and cruise context suggest same positive case but supplied text does not identify patient.

delta_expectations.reason: New reported cumulative count and monitoring recommendation are material.

ambiguity_notes: Do not double-count Dutch case absent identity evidence or infer 12 confirmed on one ship. No evidence outbreak closed; monitoring continues. Historical publication order does not authenticate version availability.
